modules.title: 旅行 Agent 到哪一步必须把决定权交给人
一个有效的人工暂停点包含什么

items.title: 把暂停放在动作之前
items.text: 搜索和比较可以自动进行；扣款、出票、发布或删除等高风险动作必须先被拦住，而不是发生后再通知。

items.title: 给人足够的决定信息
items.text: 审批不能只有“是否继续”。界面要同时展示对象、范围、费用、规则和会造成的结果。

items.title: 把决定送回同一次运行
items.text: 批准后从暂停点继续，拒绝后停止；需要修改时带着人的意见回到前一步，不必让整个任务从头开始。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Guardrail 可以按规则自动拦截，人在回路则把关键判断交给人；Auth 决定谁有权限，HITL 决定什么时候必须由人作出决定。这个术语也用于数据标注和模型训练，本页只讲 Agent 运行中的审批与纠正。

lessonPractice.title: 旅行 Agent 已经找到合适航班，下一步会直接使用已保存的支付方式出票。怎样设置人在回路最合适？

options.label: 在扣款出票前暂停，展示日期、乘机人、总价和退改规则，批准后才继续
options.feedback: 对。暂停发生在不可逆动作之前，人也拿到了足够信息，可以批准、拒绝或要求修改。

options.label: 先自动扣款出票，完成后再通知用户检查订单
options.feedback: 这时高风险动作已经发生，人工检查无法起到事前控制作用。

options.label: 每次搜索一个航班都要求用户确认，连只读比较也暂停
options.feedback: 人在回路不等于每一步都审批；低风险、可撤销的检索可以自动完成。

en.title: A travel agent has found a suitable flight and is about to ticket it with a saved payment method. Where should human-in-the-loop approval occur?

options.label: Pause before charging and ticketing, show the dates, passenger, total, and change rules, then continue only after approval
options.feedback: Correct. The pause occurs before the irreversible action and gives the person enough information to approve, reject, or request a change.

options.label: Charge and issue the ticket automatically, then ask the user to review the order
options.feedback: The high-risk action has already happened, so the review cannot provide preventive control.

options.label: Require approval for every flight search, including read-only comparisons
options.feedback: Human-in-the-loop does not mean approving every step. Low-risk, reversible searches can remain automatic.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 你可以自动搜索和比较上海到东京的周末航班，但付款和出票前必须暂停。请先列出往返日期、乘机人、含税总价、行李和退改规则；只有收到我的明确批准才能继续，拒绝或信息变化时立即停止。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: You may search and compare weekend flights from Shanghai to Tokyo automatically, but pause before payment and ticketing. Show the round-trip dates, passenger, total with taxes, baggage, and change rules. Continue only after my explicit approval, and stop if I reject or the information changes.

learning.assumes: You know an AI agent can call tools and run a multi-step task.
learning.outcome: You can identify where a workflow needs a human decision and state what the person must see and how approval or rejection affects the run.

modules.title: Where a travel agent must return control to a person
What makes a useful human decision point

items.title: Pause before the action
items.text: Search and comparison can run automatically. Charging, ticketing, publishing, or deletion must be blocked before the high-risk action occurs.

items.title: Show enough information to decide
items.text: An approval cannot be only “continue?” The interface should show the object, scope, cost, rules, and expected consequence.

items.title: Return the decision to the same run
items.text: Approval resumes from the pause, rejection stops it, and corrections return with human feedback without restarting the whole task.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A guardrail can block automatically by rule; human-in-the-loop gives a key judgment to a person. Auth decides who has permission, while HITL decides when a human decision is required. The term is also used in data labeling and training; this page focuses on approval and correction during an agent run.
